newsitem.title: USA: CBOT to de-list yield curve, fertilizer contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT to de-list yield curve, fertilizer contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade directors agreed to de-list the exchange's yield curve spread contracts and fertilizer futures, the exchange said Wednesday.
"There is staff time devoted to marketing and answering questions about the products which is not always the best use of resources when trade is slow or nonexistent," a CBOT spokesman said.

Futures and options on futures for yield curve spreads began trading in October 1996. One of the exchange's two fertilizer contracts, for diammonium phosphate, was launched in October 1991. The other fertilizer contract, for anhydrous ammonia, started trading in September 1992.

The contracts will be de-listed once the Commodity Futures Trading Commission responds to the CBOT's notice of its intent, which the exchange filed on Wednesday. ((Chicago derivatives desk 312-408-8750))
